strings.name: Yu Hua
strings.summary: Born in Hangzhou and raised in Haiyan, Yu Hua worked as a dentist before joining a cultural center. Experimental stories such as On the Road at Age Eighteen brought early attention; To Live and Chronicle of a Blood Merchant later used plainer narration to depict ordinary people's suffering and resilience. Brothers juxtaposed historical trauma with market society and divided critics. Translation and screen adaptation spread his fiction widely; his essays explore reading, memory and contemporary life.
